title.en: Half, third, quarter of a number

concept.hr: Trećina broja 12 je jedan od tri jednaka dijela: 12 : 3 = 4; dvije trećine su 8
concept.en: One third of 12 is one of three equal parts: 12 : 3 = 4; two thirds are 8

summary.hr: Podijeli niz predmeta ili sat na jednake dijelove, oboji neke i pročitaj broj; tri četvrtine sata, nejednaki dijelovi kao pogreška.
summary.en: Split a row of objects or an hour into equal parts, colour some and read the number; three quarters of an hour; unequal parts as a mistake.

title.en: Three quarters of an hour are 45 minutes

concept.en: An hour has 60 minutes: 60 : 4 = 15, 3 · 15 = 45, on a clock face
